items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: I was playing there and Eddie Atkins was playing drum on me.

ctx.x: Was Joe Oliver in that sometimes?

No, not that bad, it was the arm was they had. That's during the time. I had, the district had clothes from the tuxedo dance hall, changed it into a villa. I was playing there and Eddie Atkins was playing drum on me. And Joe Howard was playing trumpet.
And Maurice, do you remember Eddie Jackson, anything about him?
